title: Resolving spurious topological entanglement entropy in stabilizer codes
abstract: We address a systematic problem where topological entanglement entropy (TEE) estimators produce inflated measurements of quantum dimension in translation-invariant stabilizer codes. We propose a concave partition method for computing Levin-Wen TEE that eliminates these spurious contributions. We provide a rigorous proof that our approach resolves the inflation, and present supplementary analysis of entanglement patterns in bivariate bicycle codes.
key_claims: Standard Levin-Wen TEE estimator produces spurious contributions in translation-invariant stabilizer codes
Concave partition method eliminates spurious TEE inflation with rigorous proof
Directly relevant to HYP-020 TEE measurement strategy (our estimator used single-basis collision probability -- biased)
Confirms that careful partition choice is critical for correct TEE extraction
